Long Description

About the Role

The AVP Digital Opex Management is responsible for leading operational expenditure (Opex) planning, governance, monitoring, and cost optimization across the Technology organization. This role ensures effective budget utilization, financial discipline, and sustainable operational spending while supporting the organization's digital and technology objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead annual Digital IT Opex and Finance Lease planning aligned with business priorities and operational requirements.
• Develop and maintain Opex baseline, financial forecasts, and run-rate models.
• Monitor Opex utilization, identify spending variances, and recommend corrective actions.
• Establish and strengthen Opex governance, financial controls, and budget compliance.
• Drive cost optimization initiatives across cloud services, software licenses, maintenance, managed services, and other recurring IT operational costs.
• Prepare management reports, dashboards, and financial insights to support decision-making.
• Collaborate with Technology, Finance, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to ensure effective budget execution and governance.

Long Description

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Financial Planning, Budget Management, IT Finance, or Technology Finance.
• Strong understanding of IT operational expenditure, budgeting, forecasting, and financial governance.
• Experience working with enterprise financial systems such as SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Anaplan, or equivalent platforms.

Long Description

Professional Expertise

• IT Opex Planning & Management
• IT Operational Cost Management
• Budget Governance & Financial Controls
• Financial Forecasting & Run-rate Analysis
• IT Cost Optimization
• Cloud Cost Management
• Software License Financial Management
• Vendor Cost Management
• Financial Reporting & Dashboarding
• Enterprise Financial Systems (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Anaplan)

Long Description

Core Competencies

• Strategic Thinking
• Analytical & Problem Solving
• Business Acumen
• Stakeholder Management
• Cross-functional Collaboration
• Communication & Presentation
• Continuous Improvement

Location: Jakarta Head Office

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
